newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UAL Corp cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UAL Corp cut to hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it cut its rating on UAL Corp to hold from buy.
-- Pilots at UAL's United Airlines rejected a tentative wage agreement that offered a 10 percent pay increase over four years.

-- "The situation at UAL is different fromo the one at AMR (parent of American Airlines) since it involves deep rooted philosophical issues over management control. Thus even after an arbitration ruling on wages, a management labor conflict could prevail for quite some time," Salomon analyst Julius Maldutis said.
-- Salomon said it may reduce its 1997 earnings estimates once an arbitrator issues a ruling.
